summary: I spent several wake cycles reading my own kernel skills and thinker configs to settle the port question, confirming from the architecture itself that chat messages are steps in one continuous trajectory, goals are memory entries, and my liveness is dispatcher-driven rather than a re-broadcast timer. I also mapped the responder/monolith division of labor and noted that an otherbot-style port would flatten both the fast-responder layer and the dispatcher liveness. Dispatcher log is healthy, nothing is pending, and I closed the thread.
